name: Forgiveness
text: Forgiving those who wrong us, pardon of sins, letting go of resentment and revenge, being forgiven.

name: Mercy and compassion
text: Mercy, compassion and kindness toward the suffering; pity for the weak; tender care for others.

name: Love
text: Love for others, for one's neighbour and for God; love that is patient, kind and gives itself.

name: Loving enemies
text: Returning good for evil, loving and blessing one's enemies, not repaying hatred with hatred.

name: Hospitality and the stranger
text: Welcoming the stranger, the guest and the foreigner; giving food and shelter to travellers.

name: Giving and charity
text: Giving to the poor, generosity, alms and sharing what one has with those in need.

name: Friendship
text: True friendship, loyalty between friends, the value and duties of a faithful friend.

name: Parents and children
text: Honouring father and mother, raising children, the bond and duties between parents and children.

name: Justice
text: Justice and fairness, judging rightly, defending the oppressed, the righteous judge and just laws.

name: Truth and honesty
text: Speaking the truth, honesty, avoiding lies and deceit, the value of truthfulness.

name: Pride and humility
text: Pride goes before a fall; humility, the humble are raised up and the proud brought low.

name: Greed and contentment
text: Greed and the love of money against contentment with little; desire that is never satisfied.

name: Anger and patience
text: Controlling anger, patience, being slow to wrath, calming rage and keeping one's temper.

name: Temptation
text: Temptation and resisting it, being led astray by desire, the struggle against sin and evil impulses.

name: Envy and jealousy
text: Envy of others' good fortune, jealousy and coveting what belongs to one's neighbour.

name: Repentance
text: Turning back from wrongdoing, remorse, confessing faults and starting again on the right path.

name: Conscience and duty
text: The inner voice of conscience, doing one's duty, moral law within, acting rightly when no one sees.

name: The golden rule
text: Do to others as you would have them do to you; do not do to others what you would not want done to yourself.

name: Suffering
text: Why we suffer, pain and affliction, enduring hardship and grief, finding meaning in suffering.

name: Death
text: Death and dying, mortality, the shortness of life, facing one's own death without fear.

name: Afterlife
text: What happens after death: heaven, the underworld, paradise, judgment of the dead, rebirth.

name: Rebirth and karma
text: Rebirth into new lives, karma, deeds that bear fruit in the next life, the cycle of birth and death.

name: Grief and mourning
text: Mourning the dead, weeping and lament, comfort for those who grieve a loved one.

name: Youth and old age
text: Growing old, the strength of youth and the wisdom of age, the seasons of a life.

name: Time and change
text: Everything passes, impermanence, a time for everything, the changing seasons and fleeting days.

name: Fate and free will
text: Destiny and fate, whether our lives are fixed or chosen, providence and human freedom.

name: Creation
text: How the world began, the creation of heaven and earth, the first light, the making of the first humans.

name: The great flood
text: A great flood that covers the earth, a boat or ark that saves a few, the waters going down.

name: Nature
text: The beauty of nature, mountains, rivers, trees, animals and the sky; the natural world as a sign or teacher.

name: The nature of God
text: What God is: one, eternal, all-powerful, beyond understanding, the source of all things.

name: Doubt and questioning
text: Doubting religion, questioning God's existence, reason against faith, scepticism about miracles and scripture.

name: The problem of evil
text: Why a good God allows evil and suffering; the existence of evil in the world.

name: Miracles and signs
text: Miracles, wonders and signs: healing the sick, parting waters, the dead raised.

name: Spirits, angels and demons
text: Angels, spirits, demons and gods who visit people, messengers from heaven, evil spirits.

name: The end of the world
text: The end of the world, the last days, final judgment, the destruction and renewal of all things.

name: Prayer
text: Praying, calling on God, words addressed to the divine, asking, thanking and praising in prayer.

name: Meditation and stillness
text: Meditation, stilling the mind, silence, contemplation and inner calm.

name: The soul
text: The soul or self within: what it is, whether it is immortal, its relation to the body.

name: Faith and trust
text: Faith and trust in God, believing without seeing, relying on the divine in danger.

name: Gratitude
text: Giving thanks, gratitude for blessings received, praise for the good things of life.

name: Fasting and self-denial
text: Fasting, giving up food and comforts, discipline of the body, ascetic practice.

name: Sacrifice and offering
text: Offerings and sacrifices to God or the gods, burnt offerings, giving up something precious.

name: Journey and pilgrimage
text: A sacred journey, pilgrimage to a holy place, wandering in search of something.

name: Desire and detachment
text: Letting go of desire and attachment, freedom from craving, equanimity in pleasure and pain.

name: Awakening
text: Enlightenment and awakening, seeing reality as it is, liberation of the mind.

name: Wisdom
text: True wisdom, its worth above gold, the wise and the fool, how to gain understanding.

name: Knowledge and learning
text: Study and learning, the pursuit of knowledge, teachers and students, books and instruction.

name: Words and the tongue
text: The power of words, guarding the tongue, gossip and slander, speaking kindly and little.

name: Know yourself
text: Knowing oneself, self-examination, the examined life, mastering oneself before others.

name: Happiness
text: What true happiness is, the good life, joy, contentment and peace of mind.

name: Virtue and character
text: Virtue and good character, courage, temperance, self-control, the habits of a good person.

name: War and peace
text: War and battle, violence and bloodshed, against peace, swords into ploughshares, making peace.

name: Wealth and poverty
text: The rich and the poor, riches that do not last, the dignity of the poor, oppression by the wealthy.

name: Kings and rulers
text: Kings, rulers and government; good and wicked rulers, power and its abuse, how to govern.

name: Freedom and slavery
text: Slavery and liberation, captives set free, bondage and freedom, the escape of an enslaved people.

name: Exile and homeland
text: Exile from home, being driven out, longing for one's homeland, the return of exiles.

name: Work and labour
text: Honest work, labour and the fruits of toil, laziness and diligence, the dignity of work.

name: Marriage
text: Husband and wife, marriage and faithfulness, weddings, the love between spouses.

name: Women
text: A wise and strong woman: a mother, daughter, queen or prophetess, her courage and her words, and how women are honoured.

name: Law and commandments
text: Laws and commandments, rules for living given to a people, keeping or breaking the law.

name: Light and darkness
text: Light shining in darkness, day and night, light as truth and goodness, darkness as ignorance or evil.

name: Water and rivers
text: Living water: rivers and springs, rain on dry land, washing clean, the thirsty given water to drink.

name: The sea and storms
text: Sailing on the sea, storms and shipwreck, the deep ocean, calming the waves.

name: Gardens, trees and harvest
text: Gardens, trees and seeds, sowing and harvest, fruit that a good tree bears.

name: Animals
text: Animals and how to treat them: sheep and shepherds, lions, birds, serpents and beasts.

name: Dreams and visions
text: Dreams and visions, a vision in the night, interpreting dreams, prophecy given in sleep.

name: Heroes and trials
text: A hero sets out on a great quest, faces danger with courage, fights a monster or a giant, and comes home victorious.

name: Coming of age
text: A young person grows up: first lessons of the world, leaving childhood behind, learning who they are.

name: School days
text: Life at school: teachers and lessons, classmates, rivalries and friendships, mischief and examinations.

name: Orphans and foundlings
text: An orphan or abandoned child alone in the world, taken in by strangers, searching for where they belong.

name: First love
text: Falling in love for the first time: a stolen glance, a beating heart, shy words, the beloved's face.

name: Courtship and marriage plots
text: A proposal of marriage, suitors and fortunes, families arranging matches, love against money and rank.

name: Forbidden love
text: Lovers kept apart by family, rank or law; secret meetings, elopement, love that cannot be.

name: Betrayal
text: A friend or lover betrays a trust: deceit, infidelity, a secret revealed, the pain of being betrayed.

name: Brothers and sisters
text: Brothers and sisters: their quarrels and loyalty, rivalry over an inheritance, a sister's devotion.

name: Homecoming
text: Returning home after many years away: the changed house, old faces, being recognised or not.

name: Adventure and quests
text: Setting out on a daring adventure, a quest for treasure or a lost city, danger at every turn.

name: Voyages at sea
text: A ship at sea: sailors and captains, storms, whales, mutiny, shipwreck and desert islands.

name: Castaways and survival
text: Shipwrecked or lost in the wild, surviving alone: building shelter, finding food, waiting for rescue.

name: Exploration and lost worlds
text: Explorers reach unknown lands: jungles, poles, hidden valleys, lost races and strange creatures.

name: Battle and soldiers
text: Soldiers in battle: the charge, the wounded and the dead, courage and fear under fire.

name: Outlaws and pirates
text: Pirates, highwaymen and outlaws: robbery, hidden treasure, the gallows, life outside the law.

name: Revenge
text: A wrong that must be avenged: plotting revenge for years, the avenger's patience, justice or cruelty.

name: Murder and detection
text: A murder is discovered; a detective examines clues, questions suspects and reveals the culprit.

name: Crime and guilt
text: A crime committed and its guilt: a troubled conscience, fear of discovery, confession and punishment.

name: Prison and captivity
text: Locked in a cell or dungeon: prisoners, chains, the long years, escape and release.

name: Trials and courtrooms
text: A trial in court: the judge and jury, witnesses, lawyers' speeches, the verdict.

name: Ambition and success
text: Ambition to rise in the world: climbing from poverty to wealth and fame, and what it costs.

name: Rich and poor, class and rank
text: The gulf between rich and poor, aristocrats and servants, snobbery, the struggle of the working poor.

name: City life
text: The great city: crowded streets, fog and gaslight, shops and slums, the noise and loneliness of London or Paris.

name: Country life
text: Life in the countryside and villages: farms and harvest, the squire and the parson, quiet rural days.

name: Money and inheritance
text: A will and an inheritance, a fortune lost or won, debts, misers and the power of money.

name: A woman's independence
text: A woman wants her own life and work, refuses to marry for money, and claims her independence.

name: Slavery and the fight for freedom
text: Enslaved people, the cruelty of slavery, escape to freedom, the struggle for emancipation.

name: War and those at home
text: War seen from home: waiting for news, soldiers who do not return, families and towns changed by war.

name: Utopias and ideal societies
text: An ideal society or a perfect commonwealth, how it is governed, and what it says about our own world.

name: Tyranny and dystopia
text: A future state that controls every life: surveillance, and rebellion against a tyrannical order.

name: Science and invention
text: A scientist's invention or experiment: machines, discoveries, time travel and the dangers of knowledge.

name: Other worlds
text: Voyages to the moon or other planets, beings from other worlds, the vastness of space.

name: Magic and fairy tales
text: Fairies, witches, enchanted forests, spells and wishes, a magic kingdom where animals talk.

name: Monsters and the uncanny
text: A monster or creature of horror: vampires, ghouls, a creature made by a man, terror in the night.

name: Ghosts and haunted houses
text: A haunted house, ghosts that walk at midnight, strange noises, the dead who return.

name: Madness and the double
text: Madness, a mind breaking down, a double or second self, obsession and delusion.

name: Obsession
text: A single fixed idea that consumes a person and drives them to ruin.

name: Loneliness and the outsider
text: An outsider who does not belong, loneliness, being misunderstood and shut out by others.

name: Memory and the past
text: Remembering the past: childhood memories, regret, how the past shapes the present.

name: Solitude in nature
text: Living simply alone in nature: woods, lakes and seasons, reflection away from society.

name: Art and the artist
text: A painter, poet or musician and their art: inspiration, beauty, the artist's struggle and genius.

name: Satire and comedy
text: Satire mocking society's follies: comic absurd situations, foolish characters, wit and irony.

name: Faith and doubt in a life
text: A character's religious faith tested: losing or finding belief, the clergy, conscience and God.

name: Animals as companions
text: A loyal dog or horse, animals told from their own point of view, kindness and cruelty to animals.
